EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for joining us at Discover Havasu
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
{!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for your interest in ASU at Lake Havasu. We appreciate your attending Discover Havasu, and we are glad to meet students who are looking forward to their college experience at ASU.
Please find attached a photo from our hike to Tabletop Mountain!
If you have questions about next steps in the enrollment process or your transition to ASU, please contact me at XXXXXXX. I am your personal contact for admission-related questions, and I’ll be happy to help you through the admission process.
We look forward to you joining our Sun Devil family.
Sincerely,
XXXX
